response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer (13+ years) with strong distributed-systems, low-latency, and testing credentials, but the core requirement of this role — hands-on modern C++/STL development for industrial automation platforms — is essentially absent. C++ appears only in a ~6-month role at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis; the last decade has been JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang web work. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL security practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), message-broker-based C++ systems, or Azure. Domain and language mismatch outweigh the general seniority signal.
strengths: 13+ years of broad senior/staff-level engineering experience, including low-latency, high-throughput microservices
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring, workshops and public talks
Systems-adjacent depth (async I/O, fibers, caching, event-driven Geo-Data platform, Kubernetes deployments)
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience (~6 months in 2014–2015); no recent modern C++ work
No industrial automation, IoT, MQTT, or OT protocol experience (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850)
No evidence of secure development lifecycle or IEC 62443 cybersecurity practice; no Azure exposure

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation / IoT protocol and IEC 62443 security gap
Senior engineering breadth, distributed systems and mentoring
